newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI to pick up, but stay below two pct - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI to pick up, but stay below two pct - Rato.

text.p: Spanish Economy Ministry Rodrigo Rato said on Wednesday after better-than-expected April inflation figures that he saw a slight inflation pick-up in the second half on the year.
April inflation fell to 1.7 percent year on year versus 2.2 percent in March, National Statistics Institute INE said.
However the rate should stay below two percent, Rato said.

"This is a (CPI) situation than can last...Spanish inflation should remain around two percent. Maybe in the second half of the year we will have a slight revovery of a few tenths in prices." "But if the government continues to keep the budget under control, and wage increases are be moderate, we can have a period of good growth with low inflation," Rato said in a radio interview.
